component.name: Meridian Terminal
component.summary: Independently engineered Linux terminal emulator with built-in shell and local AI

description.p: Meridian Terminal is an independently engineered Linux terminal emulator written in modern C++20, featuring a robust PTY allocation layer, a high-performance ANSI/VT screen buffer engine, an optional standalone Meridian Shell with full POSIX job control, and an offline local-only Meridian AI assistant.

ul.li: High performance VT100/VT220/ANSI terminal state-machine parser with 24-bit TrueColor support
Full POSIX job control (process groups, foreground handoff, background jobs, fg/bg/jobs builtins)
Built-in local AI layer for real-time typo detection across $PATH, command risk classification, and secret redaction
Privacy-first offline execution with zero telemetry or forced remote network requests
Rich configuration system with XDG-compliant path management and configurable keybindings

description.p: Initial release of Meridian Terminal core, Meridian Shell, and local Meridian AI engine.
